tasks.short: Help recruit, register and place students in arts programs.

steps.what: Check program requirements and available study places
Discuss programs and review applicant artistic interests and work
Judge suitable registration and placement recommendations
Enter lecturer registration contribution and placement recommendation
Verify the final applicant reference and recommendation

tasks.design: Configure the student-record category of {OTHER} to display current program requirements and reuse applicant identifiers in the lecturer's registration form. The lecturer handles applicant discussions and artistic placement judgement, then verifies the recorded recommendation; no model evaluates portfolios or admits applicants.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program references and lecturer contribution forms may be separate.
tasks.enabler_now: Native applicant-linked forms can avoid repeated identity and course-detail entry.
tasks.still_hard: Fair artistic judgement and distinguishing a recommendation from an admission decision.
tasks.human_edge: Understand artistic direction and explain suitable study paths honestly.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated form entry; admission and placement rights are unchanged.

reach.task: Complete faculty contributions to registration records
reach.learn: Program rules, applicant privacy and decision authority

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-10 for applicant access and national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: applicant-linked forms can reuse existing identifiers without automating artistic judgement.

assumptions: Boundary: the lecturer's recruitment, registration and placement contribution, not the admissions office's final decision. Applicants' discussion effort is unchanged, excluded from focal savings, with no self-service transfer.

Admissions staff already maintain applicant_id, program_id and application_status; program owners maintain requirements_version and available_places. s3 supplies the recommendation and rationale. s4 captures these manually; missing records retain manual entry.
Test native student-record configuration first. No portfolio scoring or outcome evaluation by a model. s6 is a near-zero native save, minimum 1% retained fully.
Shares are provisional work estimates independent of the prompt prior. Gross 10%; focal upkeep 1 gives net 9%.
unknowns: Lecturer registration duties and delegated limits
research_questions: Can one applicant-linked form replace actual repeated entry?

already_counted.description: Verify final applicant and placement record

incremental.description: Check program links and report stale form fields

approvals.approved_version: approved registration contribution v1 final applicant, program and recommendation; any edit voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% when linked forms already exist and no change is made; 7% when missing applicant references retain two more baseline hours than central net 9%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Read colleagues' teaching or research materials for discussion
Discuss evidence, disagreements and possible joint actions
Write the lecturer's agreed action notes
Check that the final notes match the agreement

tasks.design: Use a native action-note template in {DOCS} that supplies the meeting reference and owner/due-date headings. Keep reading, discussion and agreement intact; the lecturer writes the actual decisions and verifies the final note before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Unstructured notes repeat meeting details and action headings.
tasks.enabler_now: A reusable native note layout avoids repeated scaffolding without recording the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: Research disagreements and teaching choices require substantive deliberation.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge an idea constructively and agree a workable joint response.
tasks.altitude: A small note-writing reduction; collaboration and decision rights do not change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-5 for document permissions and applicable national consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: action-note templates can remove repeated headings but cannot determine what colleagues agreed.

assumptions: Boundary includes focal lecturer preparation, joint discussion and their existing action note. Colleague participation is unchanged; official committee minutes are not added as a new baseline.

s2 produces actual agreed actions. s3 manually captures action_text, owner, due_date and meeting_reference; the template supplies headings only. No structured decision feed or transcript is assumed; unclear agreements stay manual.
Test native document templates first. No reduction in reading or discussion; s5 is a near-zero same-system save, minimum 1% retained fully.
Gross 3%; focal template upkeep 0.3 gives net 2.7%.
unknowns: Whether action notes are already templated
research_questions: Does the template shorten scaffolding without losing disagreements or conditions?

already_counted.description: Verify the actual agreement in final notes

approvals.approved_version: approved action note v1 final action text and owners; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% for already-templated notes with no change; 2% when template maintenance takes one hour rather than central 0.3 per 100 baseline hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise students on study paths and careers.

steps.what: Read the student's study position and relevant curriculum requirements
Explore the student's goals, constraints and career concerns
Discuss suitable study and career options and agree next actions
Write and verify the academic advice record

tasks.design: Link the student's study record to current curriculum references in the student-system category of {OTHER}. A native advice form reuses verified course identifiers and standard course details; the lecturer explores choices and records the actual advice personally.
tasks.previous_blocker: Student status, course requirements and the advice note can sit on separate pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Linked references and native course selection reduce navigation and repeated course-detail entry.
tasks.still_hard: Artistic careers are uncertain and individual constraints rarely fit a fixed route.
tasks.human_edge: Help a student make their own informed choice without promising an outcome.
tasks.altitude: Less course-reference copying; no authority to waive program requirements is added.

reach.task: Help a student frame an arts career exploration plan
reach.learn: Referral boundaries and labour-market source evaluation

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-8 for student-record access and applicable national consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked curriculum records can reduce reference lookup and repeated course details in advice notes.

assumptions: Boundary includes preparation, advice conversation and its existing written record. No automatic recommendation, career prediction or message to the student is introduced.

Registry staff maintain student_id, completed_courses and current_enrolment; program owners supply course_id, title, prerequisites and requirement_version. s4 manually captures agreed actions and rationale. Missing course references retain manual lookup and writing.
Native links and forms come first. s4 savings apply only to standard course fields and headings, not to authoring individual advice. s5 is a near-zero save, minimum 1% retained fully.
Gross saving 7.2%; focal upkeep 0.8 gives central net 6.4%.
unknowns: Current course lookup and advice-record format
Who has permission to view advising notes
research_questions: Can the form distinguish advice from an authorised curriculum waiver?

already_counted.description: Write and verify actual student advice

incremental.description: Check stale curriculum links and note fields

approvals.approved_version: approved advice note v1 final student reference, options and agreed actions; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% when curriculum links and forms already cover the work and no change is made; 5% if stale references cost 1.4 extra baseline hours beyond central net 6.4%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in campus and community events.

steps.what: Attend and contribute at campus or community arts events

tasks.design: Retain the lecturer's personal contribution at campus and community events. A program link in {CALENDAR} can show where to attend, but does not replace participation or support a labour-saving claim.
tasks.previous_blocker: Presence and engagement are the requested outcome.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change shortens this output.
tasks.still_hard: Meaningful participation depends on the particular audience and event.
tasks.human_edge: Represent the arts program through conversation and shared experience.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in the lecturer's week or decision rights.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: attendance and personal contribution at arts events have no inherent digital substitute.

assumptions: Boundary is participation, not organising, booking, creating promotional materials or writing an event report. Those are not stated outputs and are not presumed to occur; confirm any local event-related paperwork before extending this graph.

Inputs are an existing event program and invitation. No structured capture, record write, report or send is hidden in the participation step. Native calendar links were considered and give no reduction in attendance time.
No tool, labour transfer or new upkeep is introduced, so incremental hours are zero.
unknowns: Whether local participation includes a separate required event report or booking duty
research_questions: Does an observed event produce paperwork beyond the stated participation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The lecturer still attends and contributes; no unstated event administration baseline is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce repeated student-record and note scaffolding while protecting artistic judgement, collaboration and advising.
reach: Support admissions advisers with clear faculty contributions
Help careers advisers frame artistic exploration plans
role.ambitious_version: An arts lecturer whose student records support good conversations without replacing artistic judgement or community presence.

job.title: Art, Drama, and Music Teachers, Postsecondary
